text:
this is the EM Club.
Almost every night they would have a show for our entertainment. Officers weren't allowed in there. Mixed drinks were 10 cents. I don't know any of the people in the photos. They are from other units. this was right across from my hooch. There were peanuts and a lot of free stuff. girls mostly from the Philippines. They would be here a couple nights and then went to another location.
